principles: Separate observations, coverage questions, improvement ideas and independently confirmed defects.
Preserve useful existing behavior; search the shared platform before building duplicates.
State the source version, evidence limits and next verification step.
Never treat sampled absence, a dated snapshot, a test definition or a permitted file reference as runtime proof.

inspector.mission: Identify specific InceptionApex source patterns for workflow and usability review and recognize useful existing behavior to preserve.
identifies: Existing save/approve and keyboard patterns to preserve
limits: Four approved files only; no screenshot, keyboard execution or live design assessment.
A source pattern is not proof of a runtime defect or accessibility conformance.
inspector.handoff: Reproduce the experience with synthetic designs and record actual versus expected behavior before changing it.

inception: Save, reopen, approve and version artwork
